name: Feralas: A History
summary: Troyas Moonbreeze asks you to carry Feralas: A History back to Feathermoon Stronghold. The book matters because he is eager to have it returned.

sections.title: The Return
sections.body: Troyas Moonbreeze waits at Feathermoon Stronghold for Feralas: A History. Daryn Lightwind hands the book over, asks you to take care of it and hurry along, sure that Troyas is eager for your return.

faq.answer: Troyas Moonbreeze at Feathermoon Stronghold is waiting for Feralas: A History.
It is a book Troyas Moonbreeze asks you to carry back to him at Feathermoon Stronghold.

faq.q: Where do I take the book?
faq.answer: Take Feralas: A History to Troyas Moonbreeze at Feathermoon Stronghold.

faq.q: Why does Troyas want it back?
faq.answer: Daryn Lightwind only says Troyas is eager for your return; no further reason is given.
